purpose: Test the result-supported, coefficient-free request-breadth mechanism for the unresolved E1 homogeneous middle-load zero-completion cell: preserve the exact persistent same-seed Random scheduler command prefix, optimize only that identical emitted cohort with the paper Nash game, and atomically retain the Random initializer unless a complete same-cohort Nash proposal has nonworse immutable paper welfare, nonworse maximum admitted-service time, and strictly lower admitted-service sum.

paper_sequence_gate.action_after_failure: Retain both V153 diagnostic runs and retire the exact-random-prefix mechanism without changing a threshold or opening any later experiment.

consulted_inputs: frozen formal E1 Random, Hash, and NSESche E09/E17 artifacts

falsified_alternatives.container_count_only: V152 lowered E17 container mean and p95 from 227.014/231 to 218.397/224 but still completed zero requests.
falsified_alternatives.function_affinity_only: V152 increased E17 placement dispersion from 0.40879933740905733 to 0.833016879864421 and completed zero requests.
falsified_alternatives.structural_impossibility: Random completed 28 multi-function DAG16/DAG45 requests and Hash completed 8 single-function DAG4 requests on the identical E17 tape.

mechanism_diagnosis.conclusion: The strongest remaining causal explanation is excessive concurrent workflow breadth. Random's unchanged early-stop semantics expose a deterministic, input-only emitted request/function prefix that limits breadth while retaining all failed and unselected tasks in the simulator.

candidate.definition: Advance one persistent RandomScheduler with the frozen algorithm seed exactly once per scheduling window on a private channel. Preserve its unchanged early-stop command prefix and exact feasible nodes. The NSESche game contains exactly those emitted players, initializes at the Random assignment, and may dispatch a complete same-cohort Nash proposal only when immutable-baseline paper welfare is nonworse, maximum admitted-service time is nonworse, and admitted-service sum is strictly lower; otherwise dispatch the untouched Random prefix.
causal_inputs: frozen algorithm seed driving the persistent Random baseline
current immutable parent transfer and cold-start state
paper utility and welfare on the identical emitted cohort
forbidden_inputs: load or seed label used as a route

diagnostic_design.technical_retry: Only the frozen same-cell technical retry policy may retry; every attempt remains archived.

two state-matched policy-independent reference builds and exact replay pairing
QC pass, no unexplained quarantine, one runtime identity, frozen tapes and common HPA

fixed-window throughput at least 28 requests per second

reveal_gate.joint_pass: Every E17 and E09 requirement passes.
reveal_gate.success_action: Eligible only for a separately preregistered complete E01-E20 middle-load training block; no paper claim and no fresh confirmation input is opened by this diagnostic.
reveal_gate.failure_action: Retain both runs and retire the exact-random-prefix mechanism without threshold tuning.
